Application to amend zoning (Holding Removal) for 170-200 Northfield Dr and 570-580 Weber St N (Z-25-10)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Northfield Equities Inc. is proposing to amend the Zoning By-law to remove the holding (H) symbol to allow a child care use on the subject lands.
Be aware that a separate Official Plan/Zoning By-law Amendment application to redevelop the site into a mixed-use community is proposed by the same applicant and is being reviewed by staff.
Learn more about that application
.
This Minor Zoning By-law Amendment is intended to proceed through delegated authority to the Director of Planning. Pending comments received, the Director of Planning will determine if the proposal can proceed through delegated authority or if a formal public meeting is required.
The site specific regulations on the lands (exception C117) restricts various commercial and retail uses on the lands until the City receives verification from the Province that the owner has completed a Record of Site Condition.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details.
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.

For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
